subject: MAP kickoff — draft engagement blueprint + stakeholder/dep asks
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@healtheq.com>, Carlos Vega <cvega@healtheq.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — draft engagement blueprint + stakeholder/dep asks

Hi Olivia / Carlos —

Thanks again for a focused discovery today. Per our conversation I drafted an initial engagement blueprint (attached) so we can align milestones, owners, and the most important dependencies up front. The goal here is to land a clean pilot run that demonstrates latency/cost gains for your triage workflows and then expand into the care-management flows.

High-level summary (attached: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx):
- Milestone A (Proof-of-value): test pilot w/ 1 workflow (triage) — target window: Jan 10–31
- Milestone B (Scale pilot): add parallel routing & autoscaling config — target window: Feb 10–28
- Milestone C (Production rollout): phased rollout + SLA handoff — target: Mar 15–31

Proposed owners (please confirm):
- Healtheq product owner: Olivia Barnes — pilot acceptance and QA
- Healtheq infra lead: Carlos Vega — infra readiness & firewall/VPC config
- Redwood program lead: Priya Natarajan — MAP, rollout orchestration, weekly syncs
- Redwood infra contact: Marcus Lin — Dedicated capacity sizing and PO planning

Critical dependencies we called out:
1) Network access: VPC peering or customer VPN + egress rules (action: Carlos).
2) Data retention policy + audit log retention choices (action: Olivia + procurement).
3) Approved PE/PO for Reserved capacity by Jan 5 (action: Healtheq Procurement).
4) Red team review for HIPAA scoping (optional early; action: Healtheq Security).

Target close windows (pick one):
- Optimistic: Pilot validated + committed reserved capacity by end of Q1 (Mar 31)
- Conservative: Production readiness by end of Q2 (Jun 30)

What I need from you to finalize the MAP draft:﻿
- Confirm the stakeholder roster above (Olivia, Carlos, anyone else to include)
- Confirm the pilot target window you prefer (Jan window vs Feb window)
- Flag any hidden dependencies we didn't call out (legal, procurement timelines, or additional network constraints)

Next steps:﻿
- If the roster/timeline look good I'll circulate version 1.1 of the attached MAP with explicit acceptance criteria and a weekly cadence (Wednesday check-ins).
- I'll also include a simple cost-breakdown view for the pilot vs projected monthly spend if you want that for procurement.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx, infra_compliance_notes.pdf

Thanks — look forward to locking the roster and getting started.

—
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@healtheq.com>

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — draft engagement blueprint + stakeholder/dep asks

Priya — thanks for the clear summary and the draft. Carlos and I reviewed it quickly and this is helpful. A couple of notes:﻿

1) Stakeholders: please add our Security lead (Amira Shah — amira.shah@healtheq.com) to the MAP; she needs visibility on the red-team ask and audit log retention. Also add our Data Governance manager (Tariq Amin — tariq@healtheq.com) for the retention policy decision.

2) Pilot window: Jan works for product and data governance, but procurement timing makes the optimistic pilot target tight. Can we set a flexible start: pilot kickoff Jan 17 with a contingency start Feb 1 if procurement requires more time? That keeps us aligned with the Jan test while being realistic on PO timing.

3) Network: Carlos will follow up with a network inventory this week and confirm if we can do VPC peering or if a VPN appliance is required. We should expect a 1–2 week lead for firewall rules once we pick the path.

4) Procurement & PO: procurement@healtheq.com — we'll need an initial SOW/quote for the reserved capacity line item. I copied Procurement on this thread. If you can provide a cost summary as part of v1.1 that would speed review.

Attachments: — (we have the MAP draft from you)

Olivia
Director, Product — Healtheq
olivia@healtheq.com | +1 (212) 555-0173
